items.author: MarcieMarline
items.title: Not the best, proper, pliable yoga mat. But on for the price.
items.content: A mat. Not soft and squishy to do long poses in. Rolls up badly, not a good yoga mat.

items.author: Londonskippy
items.title: Usable but not fantastic
items.content: The mat is fine; however, the colour (I ordered the dark blue) comes off on your skin if you start to sweat/ it gets wet, so it is best suited for standing workouts.

items.author: Amazon Customer
items.title: Slippery!
items.content: Bought it because it was supposed to be non-slip and lo and behold my hands slide right out from under me. Utterly useless.

items.author: Katerina
items.title: NOT non-slip!
items.content: Definitely NOT non-slip. Waste of money, wouldn’t recommend.

items.author: Amazon Customer
items.title: Incorrect thickness advertised
items.content: It is just a regular yoga mat. Colours are nice. Reason for low stars is the advert photo says 6cm thickness which I wanted as it was for sound baths not yoga, so needed the extra comfort. It is in actual fact 6mm thickness, so false advertising.

items.author: Scottface
items.title: Narrow
items.content: This is fine - but it is very narrow (I should have checked dimensions).

items.author: Andrea Hilton
items.title: No good
items.content:
Yes it looks nice but it is ridiculously slippery.
You can not do yoga or any other exercise on a slipper mat. I did read some reviews before buying and chose to try it, however I personally found it unusable and have returned it. Also it marked really easily and only used it twice. I had bought a very cheap high street sports store mat years ago which is far superior to this one.

items.author: RJ
items.title: Not something I’d recommend
items.content: It’s an ok mat! Not the best plus there’s no straps so it all comes undone! The package was damaged and there was no protection

items.author: R.Milnes
items.title: Cannot anchor poses as slip.
items.content: High expectations but found this lacks grip. Found hands and feet slipping when deepening poses. Given to my son for rugby " yoga" sessions ie not proper yoga. Disappointed.

items.author: jess
items.title: It’s defo NOT a non slip mat
items.content: This is defo NOT non stick, it’s ok for basic plank or floor exercises but anything such as a downward dog hands just slip down the mat.
